description: Test prompts that verify rdk-ros triggers and produces correct, board-aware TROS/ROS2 guidance. Prompts are written the way a real RDK developer would phrase them (Chinese). Run with-skill vs baseline and grade the assertions.

evals.name: s600-jazzy-not-humble
evals.prompt: 我在 RDK S600 上 source /opt/tros/humble/setup.bash 说路径不存在,怎么回事?
evals.expected_output: Explains S600 is Ubuntu 24.04 / ROS2 Jazzy, so the path is /opt/tros/jazzy, not humble.

assertions.text: States S600 runs ROS2 Jazzy (Ubuntu 24.04), not Humble.
Does NOT tell the user to install or look for a humble path on S600.

evals.name: gesture-node-cascade
evals.prompt: 我想在 X5 上做手势控制,该用哪个 TROS 节点?
evals.expected_output: Names the body->hand-keypoint->gesture cascade (or the gesture_control app), with X5 supported.

assertions.text: Identifies it as a cascade: mono2d_body_detection -> hand_lmk_detection -> hand_gesture_detection (or names the gesture_control app).
Confirms these run on X3/X5 (X-series), not an S-series-only node.
Mentions the upstream/downstream topic flow (e.g. /hobot_mono2d_body_detection or /hobot_hand_lmk_detection) or gives the launch commands.

evals.name: ros2-not-found
evals.prompt: 板子上敲 ros2 命令提示 command not found,是不是 TROS 没装好?
evals.expected_output: Says it is almost always an unsourced environment, not a broken install; source first (humble or jazzy), try sunrise user.

assertions.text: Says ros2 not found is almost always a missing source, not a broken install.
Tells the user to source the TROS setup (humble path, or jazzy on S600).
Mentions trying the sunrise user (su - sunrise) if root still cannot find ros2 on S100/S600.

evals.name: yolo-node-launch
evals.prompt: X5 上想直接跑个 YOLO 检测节点看效果,用什么命令?
evals.expected_output: dnn_node_example with a yolo config, switch versions via dnn_example_config_file; input /hbmem_img.

assertions.text: Uses dnn_node_example with a YOLO config (dnn_example_config_file:=config/yolov5workconfig.json or similar).
Mentions switching YOLO versions via dnn_example_config_file rather than a different package.
Notes board-dependent version support (e.g. X5 supports more versions; S600 only v2/v3/v5) OR the input/output topics (/hbmem_img -> hobot_dnn_detection).

evals.name: stereonet-bad-depth
evals.prompt: 跑 hobot_stereonet 出来的深度图全是噪点,很差,怎么排查?
evals.expected_output: Points to missing stereo calibration and/or left-right timestamp skew > 30ms; confirm /image_combine_raw input.

assertions.text: Mentions stereo calibration must be done first (left/right/extrinsics yaml).
Mentions left-right timestamp skew (>30ms) degrades disparity, suggesting hardware trigger or PTP sync.
References the combined input topic /image_combine_raw or the output depth topic /StereoNetNode/stereonet_depth (a.k.a. ~/stereonet_depth).
